final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.district_id, d.A3, COUNT(*) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT A3, SUM(client_count) as total_per_region FROM step1 GROUP BY A3), step3 AS (SELECT s1.district_id, s1.A3, s1.client_count, CAST(s1.client_count AS REAL) / s2.total_per_region as ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.A3 = s2.A3), step4 AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) as total_clients FROM step3) SELECT s3.district_id, s3.A3, s3.client_count, s3.ratio, CAST(s3.client_count AS REAL) / s4.total_clients as proportion FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.total_clients IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(s3.client_count AS REAL) / s4.total_clients DESC LIMIT 10
